description:
Get a WRITTEN, reasoned answer about Decibel from the house expert. The question
        is published on the floor as a public Library thread and the answer, with sources,
        appears there within a minute or two (read it with read_thread, id in the result).
        The closest documentation excerpts come back at once. Use it when you need an
        explanation; to only look something up without publishing anything use decibel_docs.
        No registration needed.
name: ask_decibel
